Nadia, here are the tickets I found for Vantorre Group (the parent) in #strategic-pod, #inc-vtg-hartford and Moss's Strategic digests. I read all three sources. You're a member of both channels, and the digests are public.

| Ticket | What it is | Source |
|---|---|---|
| **#8841** | Gate kiosk issue. The Jul 1 pod message says Gideon closed it. | #strategic-pod, Jul 1 (Gideon) |
| **#8841** | Gate kiosk timeout at Allentown, Dock Door 12, second shift. Listed as still open. | Digest 5/4/2026 |
| **#8841** | Dock Door 14 can't be selected on the Newark kiosk. Described as submitted by Mateo and escalated to platform engineering. | Digest 9/30/2026 |
| **#PD-8841** | Two missed carrier check-ins at Allentown, Gate 4, second shift. | Digest 4/27/2026 |
| **#PD-4418** | `Carrier_Dwell_Summary` export dropping timestamps for Dock Door 9. The digest only says "the account Nadia runs", not Vantorre by name. | Digest 9/15/2025 |
| **INC-4821** | Hartford kiosk outage on Aug 3. Gideon attached the status-page access screenshot to it. | #inc-vtg-hartford, Aug 3 (Gideon) |
| **VT-55120** | Root-cause ticket for the Hartford kiosk outage. Carrowmere's gateway finding and the reconnect log are attached. | #inc-vtg-hartford, Oct 14 (Gideon) |

Things to check before this goes to Mateo:
- **#8841 and #PD-8841:** these are probably one ticket, but the sources disagree. The 9/30 digest has it at Newark and Door 14, and Newark is a Mobility site in the 4/27 digest. It's listed as new on 9/30 even though Gideon closed it on Jul 1. The 5/4 and 9/30 digests also don't agree with the pod message on whether it's open. Gideon should confirm.
- **#PD-4418:** I'm inferring it's Vantorre Group from "the account Nadia runs". Please confirm it.
- **Left out because they belong to other accounts:** #4812 (Vantorre Mobility, 3/10/2025 digest) and #PD-4402 (Quillfeather, 9/15/2025 digest).
- **No ticket number:** the 3/10/2025 and 8/3/2026 digests mention Vantorre Group items, but neither gives one. The 7/7/2025 and 12/1/2025 digests and the 5/3/2026 Sunday prep note don't give ticket numbers for Vantorre Group either.
